top_signals.title: ‘Air-con nation’ Singapore eyes alternatives to cool down
top_signals.summary: The city-state has the highest per-capita air conditioner ownership rate in Southeast Asia, with about 99% of private residences equipped with cooling units.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
